decisions.reason: The supplier permits counting measures on an arbitrary locally compact second-countable Hausdorff S. A measure on a singleton S is admissible there but cannot evaluate a Euclidean Borel set B+x outside its sigma-algebra. The original Definition never set S=R^d. Specifying an integer d>=1 and mu on R^d repairs this ill-typed construction without changing the translation formula or sign convention.

reviews.reason: With S=R^d explicit, translation sends Borel sets to Borel sets and compact sets to compact sets. The occurrence representation shifts every X_i to X_i-x, retains multiplicities and local finiteness, and gives theta_x theta_y=theta_(x+y) and theta_0=id. The supplied joint-measurability lemma uses the evaluation kernel with compact exhaustion [-n,n]^d and proves measurability of every translated evaluation. The local action requires no selections; existing AC and Countable Choice dependencies remain intact. The owning contract and spatial page remain compatible.
